question: In a certain code language, 'SLEEP' is written as 'TLEEQ'. How will 'DROWSY" be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First and last letters ⇒ Immediate next letter is written according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Rest of the letters ⇒ No change

​So,

 
• 'SLEEP' is written as 'TLEEQ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d984758bde14ab867c7ebf7d925d942b8e07e62391bb1dd9563757b9e445287.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbceebb8e58362ac628431d8bef3e4573e830397a8a7b76dd52db6794bceb03a.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'DROWSY' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c6533e2d6b0627c82efe7ef1fd8fba345f549470c9fc8418c48ff939569e3d1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8806dc3e7f3851e3e5bbb47a5659ed409841a60192466bf63781b12f4b9a5a9.png] 

Hence, "**EROWSZ**" is the correct answer.
